text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- E.U. administrator in Mostar, Martin Garrod, sent a letter to the (Croat) president of the Bosnian federation complaining about recent expulsions of Moslem families in Croat sector of Mostar.

- The chairman of the Bosnian collective presidency, Alija Izetbegovic, sent a letter to the Croat and the Serb members of the presidency protesting over mining of Moslems' houses in areas under control of their forces.
- A Turkish delegation donates 4 million German marks worth of aid to the Sarajevo city government.
- The speaker of the Bosnian Federation's Parliament says first session of the newly elected Federation Parliament will be held next week.
- UNHCR bus service between Sarajevo and Pale, the Bosnian Serbs' headquarters, will start on Thursday. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
